_comment: Lighthouse budgets for `make perf` (perf/lighthouse_budgets.mjs). One file for PERFORMANCE-STANDARD §1, the OBSERVABILITY-STANDARD §8 Core Web Vitals lab gate and ACCESSIBILITY-STANDARD A11Y-02, so no two configs can drift. Paths are served from dist/ by a local server; each is run `runs` times with Lighthouse's default mobile profile and simulated throttling, and the median run (by performance score) is judged.
